name: KS al Cubo Viña 2026

venue.name: [The Kingstown School](https://www.kingstownschool.cl/)

**Español** Nos complace anunciar la primera competencia de speedcubing del The Kingstown School en 2026. Esperamos poder recibir a la mayor cantidad de competidores posible y que este sea un evento emocionante para competidores, familiares y amigos. ¡Los esperamos con muchas ganas!

**English** We are pleased to announce the first speedcubing competition at The Kingstown School in 2026. We hope to welcome as many competitors as possible and make this an exciting event for competitors, family, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!
